messages:
Aisha (sec-eng): Planning AWS KMS for Redwood Private VPC: main asks — clear RBAC, BYOK onboarding, rotation with zero-plaintext rewrap, and per-tenant telemetry.
Mark (infra): Keep control-plane KEK separate from dataplane wrap keys. Prefer per-cluster DEK-wrapping key unless tenant isolation demands per-tenant keys.
Rae (platform): BYOK flow: require customer-signed onboarding manifest + one-time CreateGrant. do NOT widen customer key policy. store grant id and RetiringPrincipal so we can revoke fast.
Ibrahim (sre): Audit: CloudTrail -> secure S3 (MFA-delete) -> SIEM. Extract EncryptionContext into SIEM fields (tenant, component). Alert on AccessDenied spikes during onboarding.
Aisha (sec-eng): Rotation: for our keys enable auto-rotation; rotation path = create NEW KEK -> re-encrypt DEKs via kms:ReEncrypt -> swap pointer -> retire old key. Provide `--dry-run` rewrap that counts expected objects.
Mark (infra): Incident: if compromise suspected, DisableKey (not ScheduleKeyDeletion), revoke grants, create emergency KEK, rewrap affected DEKs, rotate service credentials, preserve CloudTrail.
Rae (platform): Rewrap runner: staging rewrap job that re-encrypts to staging KEK and attempts decrypt in isolated worker. emit metrics: rewrap.started, progress.count, rewrap.completed per-tenant. Support resume and ETA.
Ibrahim (sre): Degradation: control-plane ops fail-fast if KEK unavailable. dataplane: allow small in-memory DEK cache TTL=5m to tolerate transient KMS outage; log cache hits.
sec-bot: checklist created: [signed_byo_manifest, create_grant_flow, rewrap_dry_run, retiring_principal, cloudtrail_to_siem]
Aisha (sec-eng): Action items: Mark -> key + IAM templates with aws:SourceVpce conditions. Rae -> BYOK manifest format and rewrap runner. Ibrahim -> SIEM mapping + ReEncrypt alert. I'll draft playbook PR.
